title: A tiny squeeze dramatically changes the magnetism of exotic materials
caption:
A gentle press on exotic crystals can change their magnetic behavior and how electrons move. This simple trick could become a low‑power control for future spin‑based electronics. The research is still early, but the potential is huge.

Source: Sciencedaily - A tiny squeeze dramatically changes the magnetism of exotic materials

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261101010541.htm
